intro: Welcome to our 50 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali, where ancient wisdom meets modern practice in the spiritual heart of Bali. We made this 50-hour training for yoga lovers who want to grow their practice but can’t commit to longer teacher training programs. This course serves both yoga students who want to deepen their personal practice as well as those who are starting their journey to become teachers, combining traditional and modern yoga methods.

Our program teaches you both yoga poses and breathing techniques through Hatha and Vinyasa flow practices. You’ll discover yoga’s correct alignment and its life application while studying its philosophical meaning. Students learn meditation and mindfulness methods alongside essential anatomy and physiology subjects during their yoga education. The course shows new teachers how to lead classes while teaching you fundamental teaching skills.

Our 50 hour yoga teacher training in Bali gives students the freedom to explore yoga teacher training or expand their practice without full commitment. You can use this 50 hour yoga teacher training course as your starting point to get your 100 hour yoga teacher training certification later by taking our advanced training modules.

arrival: The 50 hour yoga teacher training in Bali starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 6th of every month. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice, and especially the teaching of yoga demands a high degree of self-discipline and purity.
In order to ensure the successful completion of the program, participants are required to attend all the provided activities, special sessions, lectures, and daily classes.

Meat, fish, eggs, alcohol, tobacco, drugs are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice. Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: Attending all the classes in the 50 hour yoga teacher training in Bali is mandatory; however, only in case of an emergency or illness, you are allowed to take a leave with the respective teacher’s permission. Uninformed leaves will not be accepted, and this will affect the student’s performance negatively.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: If you are fasting, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.
Friends or relatives will not be included in accommodation; however, they can stay in school by renting another room.
Students have to be present in all scheduled programs of Bali Yoga School.
